title: Incomplete Conquest

questions.question: Who did Israel ask the Lord should go up first against the Canaanites?
questions.explanation: Judges 1:1–2 (ESV): "After the death of Joshua, the people of Israel inquired of the LORD, ‘Who shall go up first for us against the Canaanites...?’ And the LORD said, ‘Judah shall go up..."

questions.question: What did Judah and Simeon do together?
options: Fought and defeated the Canaanites and Perizzites
questions.correctAnswer: Fought and defeated the Canaanites and Perizzites
questions.explanation: Judges 1:4 (ESV): "And Judah went up and the LORD gave the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand..."

questions.question: What happened to Adoni-bezek?
options: Cut off his thumbs and big toes
questions.correctAnswer: Cut off his thumbs and big toes
questions.explanation: Judges 1:6 (ESV): "Adoni-bezek fled, but they pursued him... and cut off his thumbs and his big toes."

questions.question: Who captured Debir to win Caleb's daughter?
questions.explanation: Judges 1:13 (ESV): "And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, captured it. And he gave him Achsah his daughter for a wife."

questions.question: Which city did the Lord give into Judah's hand, but they could not drive out the inhabitants?
questions.explanation: Judges 1:19 (ESV): "And the Lord was with Judah, and he took possession of the hill country, but he could not drive out the inhabitants of the plain because they had chariots of iron."

questions.question: What was the former name of Debir?
questions.explanation: Judges 1:11 (ESV): "From there he went against the inhabitants of Debir. The name of Debir was formerly Kiriath-sepher."

questions.question: What did Achsah ask from her father Caleb?
questions.explanation: Judges 1:15 (ESV): "She said to him, 'Give me a blessing. Since you have set me in the land of the Negeb, give me also springs of water.'"

questions.question: Who showed the spies the entrance to Bethel?
options: A man coming out of the city
questions.correctAnswer: A man coming out of the city
questions.explanation: Judges 1:24-25 (ESV): "And the spies saw a man coming out of the city... And he showed them the entrance to the city..."

questions.question: Which tribe did not drive out the inhabitants of Gezer?
questions.explanation: Judges 1:29 (ESV): "And Ephraim did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer..."

questions.question: Where did the Amorites force the people of Dan?
questions.explanation: Judges 1:34 (ESV): "The Amorites pressed the people of Dan back into the hill country, for they did not allow them to come down to the plain."

questions.question: How many kings had their thumbs and big toes cut off under Adoni-bezek?
questions.explanation: Judges 1:7 (ESV): "...Seventy kings with their thumbs and their big toes cut off used to pick up scraps under my table..."

questions.question: What was the former name of Bethel?
questions.explanation: Judges 1:23 (ESV): "...(now the name of the city was formerly Luz)."

questions.question: Who lived in Jerusalem with the people of Benjamin?
questions.explanation: Judges 1:21 (ESV): "But the people of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites who lived in Jerusalem..."

questions.question: What happened to the man who showed the entrance to Bethel?
options: He and all his family were let go
questions.correctAnswer: He and all his family were let go
questions.explanation: Judges 1:25 (ESV): "...but they let the man and all his family go."

questions.question: Why could Judah not drive out the inhabitants of the plain?
options: Because they had chariots of iron
Because God was not with them
questions.correctAnswer: Because they had chariots of iron
questions.explanation: Judges 1:19 (ESV): "...but he could not drive out the inhabitants of the plain because they had chariots of iron."

key_verse_text: And the LORD said, “Judah shall go up; behold, I have given the land into his hand.” (ESV)
